info.name: GlobalConnect Gateway 8080 Tests v4 - Spec and Regression Suite
info.description:
Extensive rerunnable Postman suite for GlobalConnect Gateway on port 8080.

Purpose:
- Regression coverage for the currently working gateway behavior
- Spec-compliance coverage for remaining teammate-side fixes
- Rerunnable without clearing databases by generating unique users/items
- Includes strict-mode toggles for future completion verification

Key collection variables:
- baseUrl: defaults to http://localhost:8080
- strictSpecMode: false by default
    false => allows current in-progress behavior on known teammate-dependent flows
    true  => asserts the ideal/spec-complete behavior and should pass once the whole system is done

Areas covered:
- initialization and unique test identities
- signup/login/authenticate/fetchaccount
- validation robustness
- add/modify/remove item
- fetchitems ownership behavior
- catalogue search behavior
- bidding happy path and denial cases
- pending payments / receipts
- payment and shipping verification
- password reset flow
- cleanup

Notes:
- Some future-facing checks rely on teammate patches:
  * payment verification for shipping
  * pending payment creation from auction updates
  * true server-side fetchitems in AuctionManager
  * keyword-aware fetchcatalogue filtering
- These are still included so the same suite can be reused as fixes land.
